steps.hint: TARGET is the upright panel on your left. Point at it for one second; locating finds a control before you use it.
Point at TARGET and press the trigger or click. Selecting chooses a panel; the panel outline lights up while you point at it.
START is the button in the middle of the desk, labelled START. The button lights up while it is pressed.
TOOL is on the left of the desk. Point at it and hold the grip button or mouse button to pick it up.

steps.instruction: Release the TOOL away from the TOOL BAY.
steps.hint: Let go over the empty desk, not the TOOL BAY tray. A released item stays where you leave it unless it is out of reach.

steps.instruction: Place the TOOL in the TOOL BAY.
steps.hint: TOOL BAY is the tray on the right of the desk. Grab the TOOL again and release it over the tray; it snaps into place.
